mapper.sql: customers.id AS id, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(cgroups.name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM cgroups WHERE cgroups.id IN ( SELECT customer_cgroups.cgroup_id FROM customer_cgroups WHERE customer_cgroups.customer_id = customers.id GROUP BY customer_cgroups.cgroup_id ) ) AS customerGroupName, customers.customer_code AS customerCode, customers.name AS customerName, customers.main_number AS telephone, payment_terms.name AS paymentTermName, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(customer_contacts.contact_name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM customer_contacts WHERE customer_contacts.customer_id = customers.id AND customer_contacts.is_active IN (1, 3) ) AS contactName, customers.customer_type AS customerTypeId
FROM customers LEFT JOIN payment_terms ON payment_terms.id = customers.payment_term_id

crm_activities_cards.id AS id, customers.id AS customerId, customers.name AS customerName, customer_contacts.id AS customerContactId, customer_contacts.contact_name AS contactName, crm_activities_cards.position AS position, crm_activities_cards.action_status AS actionStatusId, crm_activities_status.name AS status, crm_activities_cards.quotation_id AS quotationId, quotations.quotation_code AS quotationCode, crm_activities_cards.issue_date AS date, crm_activities_cards.type AS typeId, CASE WHEN crm_activities_cards.type = 0 THEN 'Normal' WHEN crm_activities_cards.type = 1 THEN 'Win' WHEN crm_activities_cards.type = 2 THEN 'Loss' ELSE '' END AS typeName, crm_activities_cards.subject AS subject, crm_activities_cards.result_action AS result, crm_activities_cards.other AS other, crm_activities_cards.created AS created, CONCAT(creator.first_name, ' ', creator.last_name) AS createdBy

FROM crm_activities_cards INNER JOIN customer_contacts ON customer_contacts.id = crm_activities_cards.customer_contact_id INNER JOIN customers ON customers.id = customer_contacts.customer_id LEFT JOIN crm_activities_status ON crm_activities_status.id = crm_activities_cards.action_status LEFT JOIN quotations ON quotations.id = crm_activities_cards.quotation_id LEFT JOIN users AS creator ON creator.id = crm_activities_cards.created_by
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE crm_activities_cards.is_active = 1 AND customer_contacts.is_active IN (1, 3) AND customers.is_active IN (1, 3) AND customers.id IN ( SELECT customer_companies.customer_id FROM customer_companies WHERE customer_companies.company_id IN ( SELECT user_companies.company_id FROM user_companies WHERE user_companies.user_id = #{userId} ) ) AND customers.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_activities_cards ( customer_contact_id, position, action_status, quotation_id, issue_date, type, subject, result_action, other, is_active, created, created_by ) VALUES ( #{activityCard.customerContactId}, #{activityCard.position}, #{activityCard.actionStatusId}, #{activityCard.quotationId}, #{activityCard.issueDate}, #{activityCard.typeId}, #{activityCard.subject}, #{activityCard.resultAction}, #{activityCard.other}, #{activityCard.isActive}, NOW(), #{activityCard.createdBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_activities_cards SET is_active = 2 WHERE id = #{id} AND is_active = 1
